free_tier.stated: No free tier. The free trial is USD 0, free for 30 days, with no credit card required and 25GB free storage for 30 days; after it the Standard plan charges USD 7 per TB per month of storage and USD 7 per TB of egress, with a USD 5 minimum monthly fee.
free_tier.notes: no standing free allowance; the trial's 25GB of upload and download for 30 days is the only free volume

per_object_cap.stated: no maximum object size on the S3-compatible gateway
per_object_cap.notes: objects under 50 KB are billed as 50 KB; that is a billing floor, not a size cap

retention.stated: no expiry of stored objects is stated; objects deleted before 30 days are billed for the rest of the 30 days, and accounts with a USD 0 balance at the end of a billing cycle and no active storage are suspended and then deleted

egress.terms: metered: '$7/TB' on Standard, plus a '$5' monthly minimum invoice floor that 'is not a usage credit'.

tooling: Native rclone backend ('storj', rclone.org/storj/), S3 gateway, uplink CLI.
chaining: nothing to chain: the free dimension is one 30-day trial per account; accounts paying with USDC are exempt from the USD 5 monthly minimum

limits.value: free trial: upload and download 25GB free for 30 days

limits_note: Objects under 50 KB are billed as 50 KB, and objects deleted before 30 days are billed for the rest of the 30 days. A USD 5 minimum monthly fee applies from the first billing cycle after the trial; accounts paying with USDC are exempt.

identity_cost.detail: sign-up asks for an email address and a password, with no card; Pro account limits follow a payment method: a credit card (some debit cards; prepaid cards are not supported), Google Pay, Apple Pay, a bank account, or a deposit of USD 10 or more in USDC on Ethereum mainnet

reliability_note: Accounts with a $0 balance and no active storage 'will be suspended and then deleted'; opting out of the 2026 repricing means 'your account will be frozen and data deleted within 45 days'.

evidence.proved: 'Free trial ... Free for 30 days ... No credit card required'; 'Monthly storage $7/TB', 'Egress $7/TB'; 'Minimum monthly fee ... $5 ... is not a usage credit'

dead_end.why: No free tier left. Current page: 'Free trial — $0 — Free for 30 days ... No credit card required'. Agentdeals records the removal as effective 2025-07-01 with a $5/month minimum fee.
